import numpy as np, time
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.EnumerateStereoisomers import EnumerateStereoisomers, StereoEnumerationOptions
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import minimize

base="OC1C2(C)CCC(=C)C1C3(C)CCCC23C"
# heavy atom index -> image px  (order matches SMILES parse)
px={0:(240,76),   #O
    1:(336,105),  #A
    2:(380,224),  #B
    3:(437,172),  #Me on B
    4:(498,280),  #D
    5:(567,484),  #E
    6:(437,382),  #P
    7:(466,502),  #=CH2
    8:(335,343),  #C
    9:(222,379),  #G
    10:(142,362), #Me on G
    11:(223,533), #J
    12:(114,500), #K
    13:(274,419), #L
    14:(271,277), #F
    15:(188,254)} #Me on F
HA=(428,50)   # H on A
T=np.array([[px[i][0],-px[i][1]] for i in range(16)]+[[HA[0],-HA[1]]],float)
T-=T.mean(0)

m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(base)
isos=list(EnumerateStereoisomers(m,StereoEnumerationOptions(onlyUnassigned=True,unique=True,maxIsomers=0,tryEmbedding=True)))
print('embeddable isomers:',len(isos),flush=True)

# random rotation grid
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
Q=rng.normal(size=(4000,4)); Q/=np.linalg.norm(Q,axis=1,keepdims=True)
Rots=R.from_quat(Q).as_matrix()

def best_fit(X):
    X=X-X.mean(0)
    Y=np.einsum('rij,nj->rni',Rots,X)[:,:,:2]
    s=(Y*T).sum(axis=(1,2))/(Y*Y).sum(axis=(1,2))
    err=((s[:,None,None]*Y-T)**2).sum(axis=(1,2))
    k=int(np.argmin(err))
    x0=R.from_matrix(Rots[k]).as_rotvec()
    def f(p):
        Yl=R.from_rotvec(p).apply(X)[:,:2]
        sl=(Yl*T).sum()/(Yl*Yl).sum()
        return ((sl*Yl-T)**2).sum()
    res=minimize(f,x0,method='Powell',options={'xtol':1e-4,'ftol':1e-6})
    return res.fun,res.x

t0=time.time(); out=[]
for k,iso in enumerate(isos):
    mh=Chem.AddHs(iso)
    cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,numConfs=4,randomSeed=0xBEEF,maxAttempts=200)
    if not len(cids): print(k,'fail'); continue
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mh,maxIters=800)
    hidx=[n.GetIdx() for n in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(1).GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
    order=list(range(16))+[hidx]
    b=(1e18,None,None)
    for cid in cids:
        X=mh.GetConformer(cid).GetPositions()[order]
        v,p=best_fit(X)
        if v<b[0]: b=(v,cid,p)
    rms=np.sqrt(b[0]/17)
    out.append((rms,k,Chem.MolToSmiles(iso),b[1],b[2]))
    print(f'{k:3d} rms={rms:7.2f} {Chem.MolToSmiles(iso)}  ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)',flush=True)
out.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
print('\nTOP 6:')
for o in out[:6]: print(f'{o[0]:.2f}',o[2])
import pickle; pickle.dump([(o[0],o[1],o[2],o[3],list(o[4])) for o in out],open('fitres.pkl','wb'))
EOF
